content.title: About
content.content: Whole grain pasta is made from the entire wheat kernel, retaining the bran and germ. When cooked it keeps most of its nutrients, offers a firmer bite and a nutty flavor compared with refined‑flour pasta.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole grain pasta provides two to three times more fiber than regular white‑flour pasta.
It has a lower glycemic index, helping to maintain steadier blood‑sugar levels.
In some regions of Italy, whole grain pasta is traditionally made from spelt, an ancient wheat variety.
Cooking whole grain pasta requires slightly more water to prevent sticking.
It is a staple in many weight‑loss and digestive‑health diets.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Fiber supports healthy digestion, promotes satiety and helps regulate cholesterol levels.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: B1, B3 and B6 are involved in energy metabolism and nervous‑system function.

items.title: Source of minerals
items.content: Contains magnesium, iron and zinc, which are essential for muscle function and immunity.

items.title: Low glycemic index
items.content: Helps avoid rapid blood‑glucose spikes, beneficial for people at risk of diabetes.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Whole grains contain phenolic compounds that protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Made from wheat, it is unsuitable for individuals with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Although more nutritious, it still provides calories, so portion control is advised.

items.title: Phytate content
items.content: Phytates can modestly reduce mineral absorption, but the effect is minor in a varied diet.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve cooked whole grain pasta with vegetable sauces, tomato sauce, olive oil and fresh herbs. It pairs well with legumes, fish, chicken and nuts. For a lighter taste, add lemon juice or balsamic vinegar.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store dry whole grain pasta in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. Cooked pasta can be kept in the refrigerator for 3‑4 days in a sealed container.
